description.value: Obanhmi is a BC-grown Vietnamese sandwich chain specializing in bánh mì, fresh spring rolls, and iced coffee, now serving nine locations across the Lower Mainland. The menu spans classic French-influenced cold-cut sandwiches to halal chicken and fully vegan options, all built on freshly toasted baguettes with house-made ingredients. Cyclists passing through Coquitlam's North Road corridor will find quick, customizable, and filling meals available for in-store pickup or delivery.
